t: Return to Eladia with the chronophone and the news.

I haven't got the heart but I'm not surprised. I've always found her untrustworthy.

What are you looking at? Take the chronophone to Eladia, she's been waiting. Remember your promise. I won't forget mine.
You owe me one.

By the look on your face, I can tell that something happened. Tell me.

…

…

Aha. Calm down. You've been tricked. Do you really believe her? The weird girl, supposedly from the future? Ahahaha! Hilarious!

I created an Incarnation and came back in time to prevent a catastrophe? That awaits if we go into another world?

Seriously now. How can anyone believe that? It's absurd.

Trust me, I wouldn't play with time. As for our plan, no one can stop us. Not even my sick sister. I didn't want to tell you about her, but since Nihaz's minion got to you... well...

My sister is a sick person who also believed Nihaz. He tricked her, corrupted her, imbued with Darkness, turned her into a monster, one of many. I'm sure our mother took care of them a while ago.

I've got the chronophone. We're prepared to leave.

Comrade Dynin told me that you're looking for Alice.

She's a mysterious girl! I would like to know more about her... but I know who can help you! Our librarian Eugenie de Doucer also asked about her. I think, she was gathering information about her. Try talking to her. She might know more.
Where have you been? The festival is around the corner.

We can't deal with Alice now.

The festival is around the corner. We need to prepare.

She and Fomkin just can't stop getting in and out!

To the town, to the mountains, to the lake! All I do is register their leaves and returns!

Please, talk to her.
h: I hear you have the camp logs. Does Alice go out often?

t:
Alice?

Hmmm... you know, you're right. She's a pretender!

Before she came along, I had been the best student! Now she's the straight A-student. She knows history better than me, she knows astral geography, and even PE is her forte! No normal human is capable of it!
Reduce the population of Ambrosia Crocodiles

The say trouble is brewing again. The Ambrosia has made someone too strong...

This time it's the crocodiles in the oasis near the river. If we don't contain them now, they'll eat everyone around them, then go hungry and die... or go after the pioneers.

We need to help them... well... keep their appetite in check.
I trust that you handled it. Thank you for this.
Help the Ambrosia Hyenas remember their place

That won't do at all!

Even before the accident, hyenas were too clever for their own good, and now they are stronger, too!

So far, they have only attacked the Orcs, but sooner or later one of the two will happen: either the Orcs will tame them or the hyenas will tame the Orcs.

Both mean trouble for the whole desert...

Go and deal with them before it's too late!
Good. Perhaps we'll tame them someday.

Scorpions are the real problem, not the Orcs!

At least you can talk to the Orcs, but a scorpion will just sting you, and it's game over!

They used to hang around the smaller oases, but lately they have been crawling all over the place... We don't need that.

I ask you to remind them where their territory ends.
Great! Let them sit quietly where they always have.
Stop the ambrosia vipers from venturing into the city

The Vipers in the oasis near the city are getting out of hand!

Soon they'll start hypnotizing people and luring them out of the city.

I don't want to start seeing bites on people, so do the same thing you did before - scare them off, and we'll reward you.
Good. They were so cute when they were small...

It's amazing how your life changes when some alien energy comes into your world!

Desert Vultures fed on the Ambrosia and forgot they were scavengers. They started to attack other animals!

If that continues, instead of reducing the risk of diseases, they will start spreading them!

Deal with them to restore the balance.
That’s good. It's better for the desert this way...

I'm trying to mend fences with my neighbors... I use what always worked in the past: the old family recipe for mojito!

The problem is, I need young cactus juice for it... As far as I know, they can be found behind the oasis, in the sands near the river in the northern part of the desert. I'm too scared to go there... But you're brave enough!

Can you help me out? I'll put in a good word for you!
Oh, it's just what I need! I won't forget this!

Remember when I told you about other miracles on Suslanger?

The local Sand Elementals are one of them. I'm trying to understand if we can create an army of them!

What? There is so much sand around, and we have so few guards.

They always appear one at a time, and always in the same place - on one river bank or the other! I'll show you.

When they die, they leave a bit of gold sand behind - can you get some for me?
Come here, little sand, I'll use you to make a weapon...
Defeat a male or female Carter Raider.

You see, I'm still trying to salvage my reputation...

I read in the books that everyone loves saviors. I won't make a good savior, as you know...

But you are a born one! That's why I've come up with a plan...

The Orcs keep raiding us. Their Carters are the worst. You can't escape or catch them... Now if you defeat one of them, I'll tell everyone it was my idea to ask you!

So they will love you and me both. What do you think?
Well, can I tell you about my success now?
Everyone will be ecstatic that we can finally walk freely near the walls!
Obtain daggers of the Court of Miracles

You've helped Kasim with the thieves from the Court of Miracles...

I also have an interest in that, but only a scientific one! Their daggers are so peculiar...

If I had a bunch or two, I might be able to discover their secret eventually...

Could you get me a few? I'll give you a scanner. It's a more advanced model than Kasim's!
Give them here...! Ah, I cut myself...
Deliver 3 crates of water to jinns in the desert and report back to Kasim Izetbekin

Personally I have no interest in the events outside the city, but my friends do...

One of them - I won't tell you his name - does business with the jinns. I'll tell you what it is, but we'll keep this between us, got it?

Anyway, he supplies water to them, and they sell it in the desert for twice the price. It's all fair, the profit is split 75/25.

I don't know what the jinns do with their share - maybe they toss it away, or maybe they spend it on something useful...

That's something to think about before bedtime.

The hardest part for you is to deliver the water to the farthest part of the desert.
Did you take the water to the jinns?
That's more like it! Profit for me and respect for you.
Obtain 10 pieces of Ifrit Pet Meat and report back to Kasim Izetbekin.

My friend makes the best kebab in the city!

He has some picky gourmets among his customers. They only eat Suslanger food!

And what says Suslanger more than a piece of meat from Ifrit servants?!

I'm sure you can easily handle it - you are out in a Storm all the time!

Which meat do you need? Any meat, just bring a lot and quickly! Champing Spider will do as well - they are like pets to Ifrits, so if there is no Storm, you can get some meat from them.
Oh, the kebab would taste divine!
Fill 5 bottles with water from oases and report back to Kasim Izetbekin.

Some of my friends make a decent living by selling unusual drinks...

And they have run out of Ifrit Water. What is that? Just plain water from Ambrosia oases which supposedly absorbs "special energies" after a Storm.

What's the difference? I have no idea, but people pay a lot for it, and we don't cheat our customers!

Anyway, you'll help us a great deal if you go and fill five bottles with water. We don't need more than that.
But we will sell ordinary water to the tourists...
Meet with Reya the Merciless on Suslanger.

It sounds like Fury might have a job for you. She wants you to meet with her sister. Here's what she wrote.

"Hi, buddy! I'm not good at writing letters, so I'm sorry if I'm doing this wrong! There's something that should interest you. It's about the worm, darn it! We've had enough of it. So we decided to deal with it once and for all. Want to learn more? My sister Reya the Merciless will explain all the details. Anyway, come over here, we'll tell you everything!"

You should pay a visit to this Reya.

Hi, greenhorn! So we meet again... Look, this desert is a dangerous place - almost as dangerous as the Astral. There are treasures and monsters! One of them is Uro-Boros, a huge worm that has been terrorizing the neighborhood. But we are the Landfill Warriors! Nothing scares us. I'll give you a thing, it'll come in handy for what we have planned.

Join the hunt for Uro-Boros and defeat it.

You can learn the details from Reya the Merciless near the Landfill on Suslanger.

We are going on a hunt for this vermin! Death to the worm! He has devoured too many of our brethren. It's time for payback!

Will you join us? Look, I think that creature has plenty of useful stuff in its belly - I doubt it can digest meteorite ore! So come with us, you won't leave empty-handed!
Patience, land dweller. Wait for the worm to get closer to the surface - that's when we'll get it!

The worm is defeated? But as we know from experience, it will be back! It's really hard to kill - even if you cut it into pieces, it will just grow back the missing parts! So come back next week, we'll be hunting it again!
Visit Jack, Meet Shlep the Slapper, Gik the Winged, Gugu the Serene, and participate in the Tropical Lottery.

I'm so glad to see you here! I have so many news - I'm telling everyone, so you're next!

First! We have... the Aviaks here! They settled at the northern edge of the bay. They are going to breed riding parrots here, can you believe that? If only our Great Turtle saw that!

One of them, Gik the Winged, organized a sailing competition here. If you want to learn to catch the wind and sail, Gik will explain everything.

Second, there's a volleyball court on the atoll now. Shlep the Slapper and Hugi the Swift are teaching people to play ball. This one, yes. It's fun, so bring your friends!

Our Gugu the Serene has also mastered the art of pebble balancing, so now he invites everyone to build pebble towers. The waves brought plenty of pebbles ashore this year - of all colors. Some clever guy says you can build pebble towers all summer without ever making two exactly alike. Look around you, those towers are everywhere now!

And you'll have to see certain changes to some of the old attractions with your own eyes.

We also have new seashells this year! The old ones are completely faded now, so we caught a few new ones. Go visit Jack Cheap, see what he has in stock. You can spend your old seashells there, too, so if you have some left over from last year, you'll get some use out of them.

Oh, I almost forgot! The lottery ticket I gave you! Play the Tropical Lottery near one of the machines - you might win something useful or get a reward for visiting an attraction.

Run along now! Don't forget to come by afterwards to pick up your gift.
The Aviaks came to visit us! They are strange.

So how do you like our new entertainment? That's not all of it!

Here are your new seashells.
Meet Pop the Puffer and Shosho the Hoarse

Wow! It’s good that you're here. We did not waste time here - we've mastered a lot of new things since last summer!

Like what?

Well, there is Pop the Puffer - he is our best bubble master. A real master in blowing bubbles who makes sure that they don't burst, and most importantly, he knows all the tricks to making the bubbles beautiful and strong. Talk to him - he will teach you the art of blowing.

And Shosho the Hoarse has learned to tame butterflies! He spends every day with them, learning their secrets. And now he dreams of showing you and other tourists his new friends so that you can also enjoy their beauty.

So go visit them. They will offer you new interesting tasks and rewards.
So, have you met Pop and Shosho yet?
Yes, that's how it is! Who knows what new activities we will discover next time!
Catch an inflatable bubble during the "Bubbles!" quest, then summon it and inflate it to the maximum size.

Bubbles are usually very fragile and burst if you touch them. But sometimes you come across unusually durable bubbles!

If you catch such a bubble, take it out of your pocket and try to inflate it. Do this carefully: if the bubble looks like it's about to burst, immediately stop blowing and wait a moment. Let it deflate a little, then continue.

If you can inflate a bubble the size of my house, I'll generously reward you!
Train your lungs! Or whatever it is your gills are called...

Wow, it's so big!

Well, you can breathe easy now. Here is your reward!

If you catch another bubble like that - keep inflating it! The reward will be worth it.
Pop 100 bubbles by using the Frog Amulet.

Do you want to try? It's very simple!

The bubbles are over there, see? They fly high above the shore, so you can’t just jump up and reach them. No, no, doing it on a mount doesn't count!

I'll give you a Frog Amulet which will make you jump higher. Then you can jump around the beach to your heart's content and pop the bubbles. You pop a hundred, and I'll reward you!
Go catch bubbles before the wind carries them away.

I'd go jump myself but it's fun watching you. You are like salmon in spring! He he!

Here are your shells!
Traveler, have you heard about our new entertainment program? It's not just fun - you can also earn generous rewards. You just need to participate in five various activities!

Did you do everything you wanted? Excellent.

Here's your reward, traveler!

We have many different activities, and you probably have your favorites! Perhaps you enjoy athletic competitions? Or you're a hardcore marathon runner? Or all of those things?

Aside from the main festival program, I suggest that you also participate in the other activities! Join any activities, and you will receive another prize from me.
Change clothes in the changing room.

Here you can undress or change into a suitable beach suit.

It costs one Seashell.

Try it!
Don't be shy, no one will peek!

That's it! For just one seashell you can change your clothes again at any time.

Have fun on the beach!
When dancing around the bonfire, perform 10 dance combinations without mistakes and pick up 24 lights.

Quarr, wingless outlander! Our festival is magical!

We believe that the fire spirits themselves, children of the hot sun, watch over us from the flames. They are there to tell you which move to make, and you need to carefully follow their hints and avoid mistakes. Then there will be lights! Pick up as many as possible, and then you will receive a good reward.

By the way, dancing takes place every hour. If you fail the first time, come again.
This was a fiery dance! Here is your reward! Come back again!
Coco the Cup invites you to Tropical Atoll to try his drinks.
A new resident of the Tropical Atoll wants to offer you refreshing drinks. Why not try them, if he's offering?
Treat yourself! And take the shells! I'm always happy to see you! Come back soon! And bring your friends!
Gather palm leaves, build a nest, and place the egg there.

Quarr, wingless outlander!

What is important for each nestling while it's in the egg? The warmth of their parents? But not just that... A comfortable and soft nest is important! So it knows its parents care about it!

That's why a nest must be built. I'll teach you how to do it: go to the forest, this jungle, find a tree with long leaves, collect them under the tree, then bring them here! Build a nest and put the egg into it!
You're off to a good start! Now go, have fun, we'll watch over your pet. Come back tomorrow, I'll have a new task for you.
Take the egg to the beach and warm it up in the sun, then return it to the nest.

Quarr! Do you feel the heartbeat inside the egg? We, the Aviaks, believe that the world once existed inside huge eggs, but then boom... the eggs broke. Now there are broken shells everywhere...

But let's get back to the matter at hand. Topical parrots like warmth and sunbaths. You need to do this: take the egg to the beach, find a special place - there is a pier with a lot of fresh wind and waves, and most importantly, a lot of hot sun rays. Hold the egg in the sun but don't let it overheat, so make sure to turn it from side to side.
Don't let it get too warm!
Sunbathing will do you both good. Good job!
Walk along the beach with the egg
Are your arms tired? That's alright, soon your friend will be running around on its own!

Quarr, wingless one! The nestling inside is growing by the day. It's getting bigger.

But the little one needs a lot of care. For example, heat and stale air will cause discomfort. So the egg should be taken outside.

Take the egg carefully and walk along the beach - it needs fresh air!
Catch 3 Fat Yellow Butterflies, wait for the bird to hatch, and feed it for the first time.

Quarr! The day has come, wingless one!

See the egg jump? It is time!

Go quickly and find a few fat yellow butterflies. They are the best for a hatchling!

Then protect it as it hatches!

Now go quickly!

Congratulations! It's a healthy hatchling.

He saw your face first, so you're his parent. He will only accept food from your hands.

Come back tomorrow to feed him.
Catch Fat Yellow and Green Butterflies and feed the fledgling.

Quarr! Lok-tan-qurr!

The little fledgling is growing quickly. To grow, he must eat a lot. Fortunately, there is a lot of nutritious food on the atoll. Yellow butterfly should do nicely, for example. Green butterfly is even better!

Gather food for your fledgling and feed him!
Catch the fattest butterflies, the fledgling needs to eat well to grow up!

Yellow butterfly - for tough feathers. Green butterfly - for good mood!

Any butterfly is tasty and filling. Should last it until tomorrow.
Walk the fledgling around the lagoon using the bird whistle to call it.

Quarr! The fledgling is happy! He's growing fast!

Well, enough sitting in the nest! He can't fly yet, but he can walk. Here's a bird whistle - if your pet gets confused, just call it.

Now go take a walk! Walk around the atoll, come back tired and happy!

The fledgling looks happy! Quarr!

I'll watch over him now. Come back tomorrow.
Catch 5 Fat Blue Bugs and feed the fledgling.

Quarr! What's the most important thing when raising a kid?

Correct! Feeding it regularly! So you must go find food for it. This time, bring it a fat blue bug - they are the best for this age!

Don't just stand there - go and find the biggest blue bug!
They have excellent appetite, so go catch the fattest bug.

Quarr! It munches so loudly! Yes, birds have ears, too!

See you tomorrow!
Pick 5 juicy nectarines and feed the fledgling.

Quarr! Today we are making a big sweet surprise for your little friend.

There is nothing more tasty and healthy for a bright parrot than a juicy ripe fruit! So you go to the grove, look for sunny nectarines in the trees, then come back and feed your little parrot!

It will be really happy!
There are nectarines in the jungle. If the local runners haven't eaten them all.

It's eating it with the skin? Eats like an eagle!

Today we rest, you'll run tomorrow.
Walk with the fledgling along the coast. Use the bird whistle if your pet gets confused.

Quarr! The parrot is growing by the day. It's time for another walk. You did that before, now do it again. It's not complicated!

Go around the atoll, and don't forget the bird whistle - in case your parrot gets confused!

When you get tired, come back here!
Nice weather for a walk by the sea!

It confidently walks next to you. Nice job!

Come back tomorrow!
Catch Red Bugs and Purple Butterflies and feed the fledgling.

Quarr! Qurr! Qwedrr!

Today we are expanding your pet's menu. Now we need red bugs and purple butterflies. It's a great combination, I love it myself!

Oh yes, grab your little friend with you. It's always trying to escape. Keep an eye on it.
Red bug, purple butterfly. Don't mix them up!

Quarr! Qwed-qurr!

This little guy is getting more attached to you every day. My heart is overjoyed!

Come back tomorrow, it will be waiting for you.
Ride a Squawker with your fledgling

Quarr! Wingless outlander! Your little friend is so inspired by your friendship that he wants to imitate everything you do. He doesn't even want to fly - just runs around on foot like he's not a bird at all.

Let's show him what he's destined to do? Take him to Deli Lightheart and go for a ride.

Even if he's on a break, he won't refuse you. It's for a good cause!

Oh, what do we have here? Quarr! Someone is flapping their wings! Now that's what I call a good example.

But that's enough for today, let it rest and digest the new experience. Come back tomorrow!
Pick 6 juicy mangoes and feed the fledgling.

Quarr! Today is an ordinary day. You will go for a walk, then pick a few mangoes! Parrots love them.

So grab your pet and go. Walk, collect fruit - it's all very simple.
There's plenty of fruit in the jungles, just reach out and take it!

A good walk and a hearty meal are all you need for a sound sleep! And when the fledgling is asleep, you can also take a rest!

We'll see you tomorrow!
Teach the pet to pick up loot

Quarr! You've walked for days and eaten well, now it's time for training! You want your parrot to pick up a few skills, don't you?

I scattered a few pouches with sand around the trails. Let the parrot learn to pick up loot.
Point to the pouch, and the fledgling will bring it to you.

Did you find all the pouches? I hid them well! A good training before a future journey.

Tomorrow won't be as strenuous. But right now you need rest!
Catch Green Bugs and Butterflies and feed the fledgling.

Quarr! Green is my favorite color. Yours too, I hope! Green foliage, green crystals that you are collecting on Suslanger... There's a reason I'm saying this!

Today you'll get a green bug and a green butterfly for your parrot. Lots of greens! Tasty!
Don't feed the fledgling on the road - wait until you are back here. He should learn to be patient.
That's very good. We'll train again tomorrow!
Train the fledgling to pick up loot again

Quarr! Days go by so quickly! The fledgling is growing! I hope you appreciate this time...

Today we scattered pouches with sand along the trails again. Let the parrot learn to pick up loot.
Point to the pouch, and the fledgling will bring it to you.

Quarr! Lok-kurr! Your friend is doing better and better! The fledgling is learning quickly. Gaining confidence. Sometimes even rebelling! Today it's a cute bundle of feathers, tomorrow - an unruly fury.

Appreciate the moment!

I'll be waiting for you with the new sun.
Now go to the egg keeper and ask for an egg.

Complete my tasks, and I'll give you a token. Trade it for a Spark from the Wise Woman. Then I'll give you another task to help you raise your parrot.

But only once a day! Can't let the young parrot overexert himself!

Do you remember where the Wise Woman is? Her name is Willa.
h: How do I raise the parrot faster?

t: How is your feathered friend? Give him regards from me and my tribe!
I have a new task for you.
That's all for today! Come back tomorrow to get your new tasks.
Find the fledgling, prepare a treat for it, and feed it.

There you are... Where's the fledgling?

I wish I knew! The wingless are saying some bird is running around the bar.

I'll be watching over the rest, you go check.

Doesn't want to come back to the nest? Wears glasses and a hat? Walks on the ground?

I warned you!

Birds imitate their owners! Is that because of your exploits in the marathon? Ha ha!

Don't worry. When the fledgling is walking, he's watching out for fish. Come back tomorrow.
Obtain Pearl Mussel Meat for Kesha

Quarr! Tagar qual kurrah! Your friend did not come back yesterday!

But don't worry, it's all under control. Growing fledglings are always drawn to new and unusual things.

Are you a good swimmer? Excellent! Collect pearl oysters No, not shells! Meat! Fatty pearl mussel meat. Treat your friend to it. Gain trust.
There are many pearl oysters on the seabed. And if not, you have to wait until new ones emerge from the sand.

Well? I told you it would like it!

Let it walk for a bit. There's more work tomorrow.

Quarr! Lok-tan-qurr! That's enough walking - it's time to do some work.

Today is training day again - you'll be picking up pouches with sand.
Capricious fledgling? Thirty of them! I'm not surprised.

What's this outfit? The wingless are a strange influence...

Your friend is back - that's good. I hope he won't run away again tomorrow.
Explain to Kesha which words are good and which are bad.

Quarr! Hello! Your friend stayed in his nest today!

But we have a little problem. These parrots... can imitate single words. But they repeat everything they hear, just jumbling words together. And we have all sorts of guests here, not just well-mannered elves. I heard words that made my ears bleed.

Please explain to your little friend which words should not be repeated. He respects you - he will listen!

If your hero friend says bad words, you reprimand them, too. Set a good example!

Now rest. Come back tomorrow.
Obtain a healing potion for the parrot.

Quarr! Your friend is suspiciously quiet and pensive today. You should go see the Wise Woman and ask if you can do anything.

I hope he's not sick. This is sad.
I'm glad to see your friend healthy and happy!

Let me guess - the past few days weren't easy for him? It's not surprising - your pet exhausted himself and ate too much!

Bring me fat bugs and butterflies of all kinds, and I will prepare a special potion that will cheer the fledgling up.
Run along the trail in the jungles with Kesha and train him to jump!

Quarr! I'm happy to inform you that your little friend is feeling better. He's ready for training!

To strengthen the wings, he needs to learn to jump.

Very well! He's getting stronger by the day.

Come back tomorrow.
Feed 10 sweet bananas to the parrot.

Quarr! The parrot is growing - he needs more food. It needs to be filling. Today you will feed him with bananas.

On your journeys, the parrot will often need to snack along the way. So today you don't need to get back to the nest before feeding him.

Quarr! Now I see that your friend is happy and fed. Which means he has enough energy for a new training.

I'll be waiting for you tomorrow at the same spot!
Run along the trail in the jungles with Kesha and train him to jump!
We'll repeat the last training today. Run and jump around the jungles, then come back tired and happy!
You're almost finished, your little helper will be ready soon.

Quarr! You did well!

I'll see you tomorrow.
Feed 10 juicy mangoes to the parrot.

Quarr! The parrot is getting bigger, he needs more and more food. Tasty, sweet, juicy food.

Grab your friend and go to the jungles! Eat your fill there and come back when your friend is full.

Good job! I hope you two left some mangoes for other bird guardians? Ha ha!

There'll be more training tomorrow.
Commission riding equipment for the parrot.

Quarr! Qwed-qurr! Well, your pet's training will be finished soon. It's time to think about its future equipment, so a wingless creature like you could be seated comfortably on its wide back.

Go see Kro the Strong Claw - he will tell you what materials he needs.

The order is ready? Excellent.

While the master is preparing the workpiece, we'll have two days to complete the training.

I'll see you tomorrow!
Complete the final session of jump training with Kesha.

Quarr! The parrot is strong, fast, and brave! The most skillful in this hatch!

So today is the final day of training! Go to the jungles! Don't knock down any palm trees.

Very well! After this training, it will soar high into the sky, I'm sure.

I'll see you tomorrow.
Feed Kesha with whatever he asks for.

Quarr! No more training today - today you celebrate!

Or rather, Kesha will celebrate. Treat him to everything you catch or pick in the jungles. Any fat bugs and butterflies, nectarines, mangoes, and bananas. Give him whatever he wants.

Let him eat his fill!

Quarr! Now that's what I call healthy appetite! Your friend seems pleased.

Tomorrow is a big day. Let him get a good sleep and spend the last night in his nest.

Come back tomorrow. He'll be waiting.
Put equipment on the riding parrot and go for a ride.

Quarr! The most important day has come, ! It's important both for you and Kesha.

You are now bound by ties of friendship and loyalty.

Collect your riding equipment and come back.

Quarr! That's it, ! Congratulations on gaining a loyal friend. Let his wings carry you towards new adventures!

I'm so proud of you! Quarr!

Now go to him - he's waiting outside.
Ask the Wise Woman, Willa the Breeze Whisper, if you can raise Kesha twice as quickly.

The summer on the Tropical Atoll is ending, quarr... Soon the sunrays won't be as warm, and bugs won't be as filling. You need to raise your parrot before the summer ends!

Our Wise Woman knows how to do it. Go see her and find out.
The Wise Woman will explain everything. Go see her.

Complete my tasks, and I'll give you a token. Trade it for a Spark from the Wise Woman, then come back here.

If you forget this, I'll remind you!
The Aviaks of the Tropical Atoll invite you to raise your own parrot mount.
It looks like the sender of that letter, Zouzou "Seven Steps", invites you to visit the Aviaks and help them with a hatch of parrots. It's curious. It's an opportunity you can't pass up.

Welcome to our big nest!

Did Zouzou send you? Wonderful!

Raise a riding mount by completing the tasks of Ar'ra the Big Nest on the Tropical Atoll.

Your progress will be saved even if the quest is not displayed in the log.

Greetings, wingless one! The Atoll is a hot place, full of sun and water, and good soil for raising fledglings.

My tribe has been breeding beautiful and clever parrots for a while now, and this year we selected the Atoll for that. But that's a problem: we don't have enough wings for all the eggs!

We can handle 38, but not 39! The wingless one should help us - take one egg, watch it, raise the parrot, then get a reward! You'll be pleased!

"It was not the Blight that brought Al Rihat to ruin. Years ago, there were goblins, orcs, and cyclops living in Umoir. And a giant named Leviathan gathered them and formed a horde which rampaged through the allod. They caused great torment before they were defeated.

Who are banshees? The souls of elven maidens that were brutally killed...

There are many of those in the area. There was a settlement of the House de Tristesse here, and many elves died when they came to Al Rihat's aid, defending it from Tugarin's horde. Then Catherina exiled them, and then the Blight came, so a lot of elves perished before they could leave. They also say that some caravan got lost on the path, and bandits attacked it from an ambush, slaughtering everyone.

Anyway, the dead maidens are raging these days, you can hear the screaming even here. Please save us from this misfortune!
Have you dealt with the banshee?
Get black boar meat from Al Rihat Ruins.

There used to be rich hunting grounds around the city.

The Blight has corrupted most of the animals, turning them into monsters that have to be exterminated.

But you know what they sang about in the legends? The Al Rihat black boar ham.

Fortunately for us, those boars still live in the lands unaffected by the Blight. Get us some meat - we'll be indebted to you.
Did you get us any meat?
Great, supplies will always come in handy.
Collect poisonous mushrooms and mutant eyes in Al Rihat Ruins.

You must be surprised to see an elf among the Keepers.

Yes, druidism, shamanism, and other folk traditions are not popular among my people.  They don't want to get their hands dirty - they consider nature too crude and wild.

I don't share these misconceptions. Even the Xadaganians offer ranger courses now. Although, their squeamishness is partially justified.

So try to be understanding about my next task: I need eyes of Searing Eyes and Tropical Muskir spores. There's no way I'm touching that filth myself. And you... you must be used to that by now. I will pay you for your help, of course, so do me a favor and collect these materials.
You have it? Oh, yes, I can smell it on you. You're covered in slime and mold. Go wash up in the pond. We haven't forgotten your reward, don't worry.
Defeat werewolves in Al Rihat Ruins.

Shapeshifters, also known as Werewolves. The result of an unusual curse.

History tell us that the first Werewolves appeared during the events of the Blood Feast when vampires were first spotted.

The Aro tribes, ancestors of the Kanians, searched for ways to battle them, but one king went further than others - Vseslav the Sorcerer with his Keepers. They found a way to turn into animals... Wolves, bears, foxes... and other predators.

The problem was, the longer they stayed in their animal form, the more they lost control of their inner beast. One day they got stuck somewhere in the middle. And now the curse is spread through a bite, just like vampirism.

But I digress. Here's your task: there are Werewolves on the southern road - you need to eliminate them. They shouldn't be there, you understand.
Done with the Werewolves? Good job, but I'm afraid we won't be free of them for long. Hunger forces them out of the woods. So I'm counting on you.
Defeat Minotaurs in Al Rihat Ruins.

Minotaurs.

Strong but sensitive people.

Take Umoir tribes - they got along fine with humans at first, but then Catherina decided to persecute other races, so now it's impossible to come to any sort of understanding with the Minotaurs.

They are blocking the northern road now.

If we want to liberate these lands, we'll have to do something about the Minotaurs. If there's no other way, our steel will do the talking!
If only we could explain that to them, but as it is, there's no other way.
Obtain crab meat in Al Rihat Ruins.

We still desperately need supplies. Umoir doesn't rich harvests, and hunting is possible only in forests clear of the Blight. So we eat everything we can get hold of. Luckily, fate has spared us the most disgusting options, because there is a lot to find here. For example, there are delicious crabs in the lake between us and the Lulleaguin stronghold.

Get us some crab meat and you'll earn my personal thanks. It's time to show these hunters what real elven cuisine is like.
Did you manage to get crab meat?
Temper steel blades in the fiery blood of Triheads.

Besides food, we need weapons.

Preferably ones that will not be damaged by the poisonous blood of local creatures - it instantly corrodes any steel blade. I wondered if anything could be done about it, and realized that we need to use the tools at hand. Let me explain. Regular lake Hydras have recently mutated into Triheads, fire-breathing monsters with flame running through their veins.

With it, you can temper ordinary blades by charging them with magic. Just immerse them in Trihead blood.

I entrust you with this mission.
Did you manage to temper the blades?
Excellent, wonderful blades. I can feel the heat emanating from them.
Defeat Troublemaker, who lives in the Mighty Oak.

One of our enemies is Troublemaker, the crazed forest spirit. Perhaps, he was a forest guardian for birds and animals once, but now he is completely insane. He throws stones at people and curses over every hill and dale. He needs to be punished! Can you do it?
Has Troublemaker stopped making trouble? Wonderful!
Defeat the witch Nessora in Foremother's Temple.

My cousin, Prince Dakkar, and his father, our king, don't get along. I think, the Kanian girl, Svetlana, is their apple of discord. The union of an elf and a human is rare and quite unusual. Just remember the scandalous union of Ademar de Tristesse and Baba Yaga!

The Kanian was a witch. There are a lot of them here, on Umoir. I find witchcraft quite savage, although the first witches were elven, of course. But that was so long ago that it isn't worth mentioning. You can ask Zayan about Nemeina and her ravens if you like.

Apart from the three sisters on Umoir, there were other witches. Nessora, a nasty cannibal and a necromancer, is one of the strongest living witches. She's hiding out in the ruins of the Foremother's Temple - a temple of a local mysterious god. Find and kill her.
Defeat Tord the Fierce in a swamp near the Sorceress' Tower

It's not easy job to be a monster hunter. I have to hang around all day, waiting volunteers to take my quest. It's a little boring.

On the other hand, the monsters seem to have fun. Why else would they drag their buddies to these lands? We've got enough of them here as it is. Here's the story: goblins have hired a new beast as a guard, and it ran away without a second thought.

The locals call it Tord the Fierce. I have no idea what it is. It may be a toad or a troll. In any case, it's big, slimy, and it stinks like all swamps of the world. It lies in wait in the lair under the Sorceress' Tower, ambushing merchants. You need to kill it before it has a litter.
Did you defeat the monster? Great.
Defeat Stump in the Stronghold of the Guardian Ring

Blight is a curious phenomenon. I hear it drives animals crazy and gives them incredible strength. My cousin Amanda is studying this mysterious thing.

Unfortunately, we still have to face the consequences. The worst of all is when the Blight corrupts a guardian of the Nature. I'm talking about Treants. Or was it Tree-ants? I don't remember. It doesn't matter.

Before the vampires were kicked out from the Patriarch's residence, the local Guardian Ring was located in the old stronghold west of the town. This wasn't the most peaceful location, so the guardians were forced to leave. A rotten Treant was spotted there recently. We named it Stump. This isn't a simple monster. I'm sure it's planning something evil. We don't want to just sit here and wait till a horde of corrupted beasts jump out from there. Please, kill Stump.
Is Stump dead? Great. This place will be much more peaceful now.
Defeat vampires in Al Rihat Ruins.

I think of other members of my House, those who managed to escape Drowsy Woods. Without Alir and Annette, the task of leading our House to prosperity falls to me...

But the idea of prosperity is probably laughable... There are so few of us left...

Alright, no time for melancholy. The great de Delice offered us their support, and here we work with the Keepers and hunters.

But there's something they can't do. While we were in exile, our abode was seized. Yes, the accursed House de Doucer. We drove them out of the Patriarch's residence, but our Chateau Tristesse is still crawling with the bloodthirsty bastards! It's our duty to get rid of them. I beg you to help us.
Our home will be liberated! I believe that.
